hideSecuritySystem.title: Hide Home Security System
hideSecuritySystem.description: Do not expose the Homematic IP security system in HomeKit.

devices.title: Per-device Options
devices.description: Add a device using its Homematic IP device ID, then select the options to apply to it. Device-specific options are ignored for other device types.

id.title: SGTIN / Serial Number
id.description: The device identifier shown as SGTIN in the Homematic IP app and as Serial Number in the Apple Home app.

hide.title: Hide Device
hide.description: Applies to all devices. Remove this device and its services from HomeKit.

asClimateSensor.title: Expose as Climate Sensor
asClimateSensor.description: Wall thermostats only (for example HmIP-WTH, HmIP-WTH-2, HmIP-WTH-B, HmIP-BWTH, HmIP-STH and HmIP-STHD). Hide the temperature controls and expose only the climate sensor functions.

lightSensor.title: Expose Light Sensor
lightSensor.description: Motion detectors only (HmIP-SMI, HmIP-SMO-A and HmIP-SMI55). Add their brightness measurement as a HomeKit light sensor.

lightSwitch.title: Expose Light Switch
lightSwitch.description: Garage door modules only (HmIP-MOD-TM and HmIP-MOD-HO). Add a HomeKit switch for the module's optional light output.

openLatch.title: Open Latch when Unlocking
openLatch.description: HmIP-DLD door lock drive only. Pull the latch after unlocking so the door opens completely.

pin.title: Authorization PIN
pin.description: HmIP-DLD door lock drive only. Enter the optional PIN assigned in the Homematic IP app under Settings / Access Authorizations.

separateChannels.title: Expose Channels as Separate Accessories
separateChannels.description: Multi-mode inputs (HmIPW-DRI16 and HmIP-FCI6) and multichannel dimmers (HmIPW-DRD3 and HmIP-DRDI3) only. Expose each assigned input or dimmer output as a separate HomeKit accessory so it can be assigned to its own room.

simpleSwitch.title: Expose as Simple Switch
simpleSwitch.description: HmIP-BSL notification light switch only. Expose the switch without the two top and bottom light services.

withRainSensor.title: Expose Rain Sensor
withRainSensor.description: Weather sensors with rain detection only (HmIP-SWO-PL and HmIP-SWO-PR). Add an occupancy-style HomeKit sensor that indicates rain.

withStormSensor.title: Expose Storm Sensor
withStormSensor.description: HmIP-SWO-B, HmIP-SWO-PL and HmIP-SWO-PR weather sensors only. Add an occupancy-style HomeKit sensor that indicates a storm.

withSunshineSensor.title: Expose Sunshine Sensor
withSunshineSensor.description: HmIP-SWO-B, HmIP-SWO-PL and HmIP-SWO-PR weather sensors only. Add an occupancy-style HomeKit sensor that indicates sunshine.

withWindSpeedSensor.title: Expose Wind Speed Sensor
withWindSpeedSensor.description: HmIP-SWO-B, HmIP-SWO-PL and HmIP-SWO-PR weather sensors only. Add an occupancy-style HomeKit sensor that indicates elevated wind speed.
